specialRules.name: Strictures
specialRules.summary: Dragon and Warrior Monks cannot wear armour.

specialRules.name: Distaste for Poison
specialRules.summary: Dragon and Warrior Monks cannot use poisons or venom.

specialRules.name: Outsiders
specialRules.summary: Only Hired Swords explicitly permitting Battle Monks may be hired.

specialRules.name: Ride Horse
specialRules.summary: Trained to ride horses.

specialRules.name: Decree
specialRules.summary: After the Emissary dies, replace him before buying other warriors or equipment; he resumes leadership.

specialRules.name: Unarmed Combat
specialRules.summary: No unarmed penalties and +1 Attack when unarmed.

specialRules.name: Art of Silent Death
specialRules.summary: Unarmed attacks cause critical wounds on 5-6; quarter-staff attacks do not gain this benefit.

specialRules.name: Unarmed Combat
specialRules.summary: No unarmed penalties and +1 Attack when unarmed.

specialRules.name: Simple Folk
specialRules.summary: Cannot gain experience; fight unarmed without penalties.

specialRules.name: Mob
specialRules.summary: +1 Leadership per other allied peasant within 3 inches; cannot use the leader's Leadership.

specialRules.name: Ignored
specialRules.summary: Peasant casualties do not contribute to the rout-test casualty count.

items.name: Cathayan silk cloak
items.ruleText: Emissary only. Resolve the cloak's effects using the full source.

items.name: Horse
items.ruleText: Emissary only; Ride Horse is recorded on the Emissary's profile.

items.name: Katana
items.ruleText: Dragon Sword: armour piercing; +1 Initiative when charging.

items.name: Brace of Duelling Pistols
items.ruleText: Source brace cost: 60 gc. Contains two pistols and counts as one missile weapon toward the two-missile-weapon carrying limit.

specialRules.name: Eye of the Gods
specialRules.summary: After a battle with an unmarked leader present, resolve the source's 2D6 reward or transformation test manually.

specialRules.name: Tribes
specialRules.summary: Choose Norse, Kurgan or Hung manually. Norse gain +1 rarity and a 13+ Eye threshold; Kurgan have unrestricted Warhound numbers, bow access and -1 rarity except their special weapons; Hung have capacity 12 and discounted warhorses.

specialRules.name: Marks
specialRules.summary: Marks affect magic, Leadership, recruits and bonuses; record the chosen mark and adjudicate its effects manually.

specialRules.name: Hired Swords
specialRules.summary: May hire Pit Fighters, Ogre Bodyguards, Norse Shamans and Imperial Assassins. Warlocks and Witches are forbidden while any warrior has the Mark of Arkhar; mark restrictions remain manual.

hiredSwordPolicy.summary: Marauders may hire Pit Fighters, Ogre Bodyguards, Norse Shamans and Imperial Assassins. Warlocks require no warrior with the Mark of Arkhar; verify this manually. Other Hired Swords must explicitly permit Marauders.

specialRules.name: Animals
specialRules.summary: Cannot gain experience or use equipment; fight with natural weapons.

specialRules.name: Special Movement and Attacks
specialRules.summary: Moves 2D6 straight ahead; contact counts as a charge. Roll D6+1 Attacks each combat phase.

specialRules.name: Mindless
specialRules.summary: Causes fear, automatically passes Leadership tests and gains no experience.

specialRules.name: Large
specialRules.summary: Counts as a Large Target.

specialRules.name: Inconsistency
specialRules.summary: Determine WS, S, T and A when needed each turn until individually fixed by advances.

specialRules.name: Fate
specialRules.summary: Uses no equipment until all variable characteristics are fixed; at 90 XP with any variable characteristics remaining, becomes a Spawn or leaves if a Spawn already exists.

specialRules.name: Fear
specialRules.summary: Causes fear.

items.name: Steel whip
items.ruleText: Barbed Whip: retained legacy alias. Resolve its special rules from the source.

specialRules.name: Animosity
specialRules.summary: Roll at the start of each turn; on 1 the Night Goblins squabble instead of acting. Non-goblins are unaffected.

specialRules.name: Hate Stunties
specialRules.summary: Night Goblins hate Dwarfs; Fanatics and non-goblins do not receive this hatred.

specialRules.name: Snotling Mob
specialRules.summary: Initially hire five Snotlings for 50 GC; replace losses for 10 GC each. The whole mob counts as one model for capacity, income and rout tests; adjust those special counts manually.

specialRules.name: Movement
specialRules.summary: Move 2D6 inches; cannot run or declare charges, but contact counts as charging.

specialRules.name: Minderz
specialRules.summary: Remain within 6 inches of a Goblin; otherwise go wild and move randomly for the rest of the battle.

specialRules.name: Animals
specialRules.summary: No equipment or experience.

specialRules.name: Addict
specialRules.summary: Needs Madcap Mushrooms each battle or cannot take part.

specialRules.name: Mushroom Brain
specialRules.summary: Cannot gain experience.

specialRules.name: Looney and Frantic
specialRules.summary: Frenzied; test mushroom damage after battle, and strike first ignoring Initiative and weapon ordering.

specialRules.name: Fear and Stupidity
specialRules.summary: Causes fear and is subject to stupidity.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.summary: Ignore wounds on 4+ except fire wounds; never roll post-battle injuries.

specialRules.name: Always Hungry
specialRules.summary: Pay 15 GC after each game or sacrifice two Goblins or Squigs; otherwise the Troll leaves.

specialRules.name: Vomit Attack
specialRules.summary: May replace normal attacks with one automatic S5 hit ignoring armour.

specialRules.name: Dumb Monster
specialRules.summary: No experience or equipment.

specialRules.name: Mob
specialRules.summary: Initially five models, stay within 1 inch and fight together.

specialRules.name: Weedy
specialRules.summary: Injury: 1 knocked down, 2-3 stunned, 4-6 out of action.

specialRules.name: Dodgy
specialRules.summary: 6+ dodge save against shooting.

specialRules.name: Insignificant
specialRules.summary: Mob counts as one for capacity, income and rout tests; enemies earn casualty XP only for removing its last member.

skills.name: Sneaky Git
skills.summary: After deployment move D3 friendly models; Big Boss only.
